dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Those two weirdos are up to it again...

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I often see them coming here to read, but I never expected to encounter them during Lantern Rite as well.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: All I hear them talking about is "evil spirits" or somesuch, though. Are they writing a story, by any chance?
